Partner Directory

The Shopify Partner Directory is a curated list of Shopify Partners within our global Partner ecosystem. Through this directory, Shopify merchants can explore Partners and the services they offer, and reach out to Partners to start the collaboration process.

Marketing and sales

Visual content and branding
Expert guidance

Through this directory, you can explore Partners and the services they offer, and reach out to Partners to start the collaboration process.

The Shopify Partner Directory is available only in English.

Note

As of October 2023, the Shopify Partner Directory has replaced the Shopify Experts Marketplace.
